outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative ex vivo bright-field and fluorescence photographs of lungs, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar graph of mean ICG fluorescence intensity with SD error bars also overlays individual data points for each mouse (blue and red dots), satisfying the requirement.
Panel C consists of H&E/fluorescence/RNAscope micrographs and spatial transcriptomic feature plots (Cd68, Spp1), not bar/mean plots requiring individual points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values per gene derived from differential expression testing (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test) across the spatial transcriptomics dataset, representing a single computed statistic per gene rather than a mean across discrete biological replicates, so overlaying individual data points is not applicable.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images, not a plot of averaged data.
